title: Aurora Lake
description: A living lake beneath close aurora curtains
music_direction: Three Lyria 3.5 movements in D major (still water, curtains of light, return to stillness): warm analog pads, a D and A drone and distant glass harmonics over a soft felt-mallet note that Lyria plays on every beat at 60 BPM, joined on bar lines so the beat never breaks.

title: Prismatic Sanctuary
description: A flowing jewel tunnel beneath a woven particle vault
music_direction: A moving, spacious 60 BPM electronic journey, every beat on the breath ticks: warm choir-like synth pads, suspended ninths, a gradual minor-to-major opening, slow legato melodic responses, rounded heartbeat pulses, sustained bass and diffused echoes. Five movements rise gently into luminous harmony and settle into a long soft release. No speech, sampled voices, piano, plucked attacks or independently timed backing music.

title: Fractal Garden
description: A sculpted kaleidoscope of evolving Mandelbrot fields
music_direction: Recursive glass harmonics in nested three- and six-note canons over a quiet glass pulse on every beat at 60 BPM, beneath slowly unfolding harmonic fields.

title: Tidal Origami
description: Suspended liquid loops and breathing water petals
music_direction: Three Lyria 3.5 movements in A major (a spacious welcome, deeper water, resolving into stillness): low singing bowls, fluid bowed-glass resonances and a deep warm bass under soft felt-piano droplets that Lyria plays on every beat at 60 BPM, joined on bar lines so the pulse never breaks.

title: Cloud Atelier
description: Layered cloud islands with a breathing vortex
music_direction: Weightless sustained string-like harmonics, airy vowel-free glass tones and long overlapping swells over a soft, low breathing bloom on every beat at 60 BPM. No drums.

title: Neural Constellation
description: A deeper living network of converging signals
music_direction: Rounded cellular sine resonances answer across the stereo field on a gentle 60 BPM firing pulse over an evolving warm harmonic network.

title: Circuit Garden
description: Nested circuit assemblies with flowing charge
music_direction: Warm analogue oscillator chords and softly charged electronic tones sequenced on a gentle 60 BPM pulse. No acoustic instruments or drums.

title: Pilgrim Tides
description: Braided processions and a gathering of lantern figures
music_direction: Three Lyria 3.5 movements in F major (setting out, walking together, arriving): warm chamber strings and a soft low clarinet over an unhurried felt-piano walking pulse that Lyria plays on every beat at 60 BPM, joined on bar lines so the pulse never breaks.

title: Visionary Temple
description: A sculpted tunnel of eyes, jewels, flames, feathers, lotuses and crystals opening into a temple
music_direction: A single deterministic 60 BPM psybient journey aligned to the sixteen-second breath: tanpura-like drone, a sub-bass heartbeat on every tick, breath-shaped sixteenth-note plucked arpeggios, glass shimmer and wordless formant pads, moving through eight harmonic passages that dissolve with the tunnel.
